note: the page's title: the options window's title and the Settings window's button

value: 打开坐骑图鉴。在那里选择你的坐骑，并设置它的名字、外观、幼崽和颜色。
english: Opens the Mount Journal. Pick your mount there and set its name, skin, babies and colours.

value: 召唤你的坐骑并骑上去。再按一次即可下来。驾驶板车时按下，板车会留在原地，你继续骑行。
english: Calls your mount and gets you on. Press it again to get off. In the cart, it leaves the cart standing and you ride on.

value: 召唤你的坐骑和它的板车，让你驾驶。再按一次即可下来。骑乘时按下，坐骑会把板车带来。
english: Calls your mount with its cart so you can drive. Press it again to get off. While riding, it brings the cart.
Rings the bell while you drive the cart.

value: 骑乘时让坐骑鸣叫，它的幼崽会回应。
english: Your mount calls out while you ride, and its babies answer.

value: 送走你的坐骑、它的板车和幼崽。板车上的货物会先卸下来。
english: Sends your mount, its cart and its babies away. The cart's load is put down first.

value: 骑乘时让坐骑跳跃。按住按键可以跳得更高。战斗中Space键会改为攻击，所以如果想在战斗中跳跃，请另设一个按键。
english: Your mount jumps while you ride. Hold the key to jump higher. In a fight, Space attacks instead, so set another key if you want to jump while fighting.

value: 让会飞的坐骑起飞。飞行中再按一次即可降落。如果它与跳跃共用按键，先跳起来，再在空中按下即可起飞。战斗中Space键会改为攻击。
english: Takes off on a mount that can fly. Press it again while flying to land. If it shares the Jump key, jump first and press it in the air to take off. In a fight, Space attacks instead.
Hold it while flying to go up.

value: 飞行时按住即可下降。碰到地面时就会降落。
english: Hold it while flying to go down. You land when you reach the ground.

value: 打开坐骑图鉴。在那里选择你的坐骑，并设置它的名字、外观、幼崽和颜色。
english: Opens the Mount Journal. Pick your mount there and set its name, skin, babies and colours.
Keep your mount with the save

value: 读取存档后，你的坐骑和板车会连同货物待在你离开时的位置。它们保存在每个存档旁边的一个小文件里，Steam云会同步该文件。
english: After you load a game, your mount and cart are where you left them, with their load. They are kept in a small file next to each save, which Steam Cloud syncs.
Say why you can't get on

value: 守墓人会在思考气泡里说明原因。
english: The keeper says why in a thought bubble.
note: Mount Behaviour, a switch: its description

value: 坐骑在没有板车、原地等待时，会不时慢慢走上几步。
english: Your mount takes a few slow steps now and then while it waits without its cart.
note: Mount Behaviour, a switch: its description

value: 骑着坐骑进入房屋、教堂和太平间。穿过带加载画面的门时，骑乘仍会结束。
english: Ride into houses, the church and the morgue. Doors with a loading screen still end the ride.
note: Mount Behaviour, a switch: its description

value: 允许带板车在室内骑乘
english: Allow mounting with the cart indoors

value: 板车也会跟进室内。它在室内没有碰撞体积，所以会直接穿过家具和门框，而不会被卡住，只是看起来有点怪。关闭时，板车会在门口等候。
english: The cart comes inside too. It has no collider indoors, so it rolls through furniture and door frames rather than getting stuck; it only looks odd. When this is off, the cart waits at the door.
note: Mount Behaviour, a switch: its description

value: 驾驶板车时捡起的僵尸会躺在板车上。你可以直接从板车上把它们派去干活。
english: Zombies you pick up while driving lie on the cart. You can hand them to their work from there.
A storage chest rides on the cart

value: 驾车靠近储物箱子并按下工作键，即可把它连同里面的所有东西装上板车。在面前没有任何东西时按下交互键，即可将它放下。
english: Drive up to a storage chest and press the Work key to load it with everything inside. Press the Interact key with nothing in front of you to set it down.
Carry the corpse into the morgue

value: 板车载着尸体穿过太平间的门时，你会抱着尸体走进去。板车在外面等候。
english: Drive through the morgue door with a corpse on the cart and you walk in carrying it. The cart waits outside.

value: 毛驴把尸体留在十字路口
english: Donkey leaves corpses at the crossroads

value: 游戏中运送尸体的毛驴会把新尸体留在十字路口，而不是太平间门前。你得亲自把它们运回来。
english: The game's delivery donkey leaves new bodies at the crossroads instead of in front of the morgue. You bring them in yourself.

value: 坐骑会不时叫上几声，你骑上去时也会叫。
english: Your mount calls out now and then, and when you get on.

value: 停驻的坐骑和幼崽发出声音
你附近停着的坐骑和幼崽也会发出声音。关闭时，你只能听到正在骑乘的坐骑。
english: Parked mounts and babies near you make their sounds too. When this is off, you only hear the mount you ride.

value: 掉出世界时把我送回来
english: Bring me back if I fall out of the world

value: 如果你掉出了世界，会被送回你最后站过的地面上。
english: If you fall out of the world, you are put back on the last ground you stood on.
note: Safe spot, a switch: its description

english: Back to the last safe spot

value: 把你送回最后站过的地面上。被卡住时可以使用。
english: Puts you back on the last ground you stood on. Use it if you get stuck.
note: Safe spot, a key: its description

english: Back to the last safe spot

value: 立即把你送回最后站过的地面上。
english: Puts you back on the last ground you stood on, right now.
note: Safe spot, a button: its description

value: 所有能拉板车的坐骑都能装载6件物品，无论其自身载货量是多少。
english: Every mount that pulls a cart carries 6 items, whatever its own cargo.
All mounts have the same speed

value: 所有坐骑（包括毛驴）都以下方选择的速度移动。带着板车时会照常慢一些。
english: Every mount, the donkey too, goes at the speed you pick below. With the cart it is slower, as always.

note: a mount's name (the Mount Journal; the keeper's bubbles)

value: 会说话的骷髅头终于派上了用场。他全凭一股子主见蹦跳着前进，而且一路上还有一大堆高见要跟你分享。
english: The talking skull finally makes himself useful. He hops along on pure opinion, and he has plenty of it to share on the way.
note: a mount's description in the Mount Journal
